common.title: Major Cyber Incident
common.line: A large, largely automated attack lands.

common.title: Evaluation Anomalies Escalate
common.line: Benchmark results from an unreleased system leak, or an evaluation team reports behaviour it cannot explain – capability appearing where it was not trained, an eval saturating far earlier than projected, or agents behaving differently when they appear to judge they are being watched.

common.title: Knowledge Work Is Boosted, Not Replaced
common.line: The evidence arrives from ordinary offices rather than from laboratories: measured productivity gains in law, accountancy, administration, journalism and consulting, largest among the least experienced, and no matching fall in employment.

notable.title: Frontier Access Denied
notable.line: The Union is cut off from the leading model at short notice, wholly or by nationality of user.

notable.title: Swarm toolkit proliferation
notable.line: Forensic write-ups of the autumn grid, port and water-utility intrusions circulate widely enough that criminal and copycat groups repurpose the published swarm techniques for smaller intrusions against municipal utilities and hospitals.

notable.title: Utility insurance crunch
notable.line: A major European insurer reprices cyber cover for municipal utilities and hospitals after the autumn intrusions, triggering deferred maintenance cuts and public blame over who pays for hardening.
